## Panels

Builds a custom screen from LEDs, buttons, text, plots, bargraphs, pictures and
meters. The main-menu entry formerly called Command Panel is now Panels.

The current page number appears flush against the upper-right edge as dark-gray
text on a black rounded badge. Numbers start at 1.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Cancel | Toggle locked run mode and unlocked edit mode |
| Hold Cancel | This help page |
| Page | Cycle existing pages and wrap to the first |
| Gray | Add a control |
| Yellow | Select the next control or choose the panel tile |
| Green | Toggle move/resize or choose panel background color |
| Blue | Edit properties or add a panel |
| Red | Edit a control event |
| Ok | Leave property or event editing |
| Touch empty area | Deselect the control and show panel properties |

New Button controls are 100 pixels wide by 30 pixels high. Move and resize use
10-pixel steps and clamp controls to the display.

An empty project shows Load Wili File. Explicit startup selection is stored in
`1:/wilifiles/default.wili.txt`; without that marker, the first `.wili` in
`1:/wilifiles/default/` remains the compatibility fallback.
